passage.text: A room in the university dormitory is available from June 1st.
passage.reading: ə ˈruːm ɪn ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈdɔːrmətɔːri ɪz əˈveɪləbəl frəm ˈdʒuːn ˈfɜːrst.

passage.text: It's a two-person room, so you will share it with a roommate.
passage.reading: ɪts ə ˌtuː ˈpɜːrsən ˈruːm, soʊ juː wɪl ˈʃɛr ɪt wɪð ə ˈruːmmeɪt.

passage.text: Your roommate is a second-year student, and she studies economics.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈruːmmeɪt ɪz ə ˌsɛkənd ˈjɪr ˈstuːdənt, ənd ʃiː ˈstʌdiz ˌɛkəˈnɑːmɪks.

passage.text: The rent is three thousand baht per month, and it includes water and electricity.
passage.reading: ðə ˈrɛnt ɪz ˈθriː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt pər ˈmʌnθ, ənd ɪt ɪnˈkluːdz ˈwɔːtər ənd ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti.

passage.text: You can't cook in the room, but there's a kitchen on every floor.
passage.reading: juː ˈkænt ˈkʊk ɪn ðə ˈruːm, bʌt ðɛrz ə ˈkɪtʃən ɑːn ˈɛvri ˈflɔːr.

passage.text: Guests can visit until nine o'clock at night.
passage.reading: ˈɡɛsts kən ˈvɪzɪt ənˈtɪl ˈnaɪn əˈklɑːk ət ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: You must not smoke in the dormitory, and please be quiet after ten o'clock.
passage.reading: juː mʌst ˈnɑːt ˈsmoʊk ɪn ðə ˈdɔːrmətɔːri, ənd ˈpliːz bi ˈkwaɪət ˈæftər ˈtɛn əˈklɑːk.

passage.text: Please come to the dormitory office before May 25th.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈkʌm tə ðə ˈdɔːrmətɔːri ˌɔːfɪs bɪˈfɔːr ˈmeɪ ˌtwɛnti ˈfɪfθ.
